Our hotline operates 24/7, offering confidential and compassionate assistance to callers seeking help, information, and referrals to local treatment and support services. SafeSpot aims to reduce overdose deaths and improve access to addiction treatment and support across the state of Massachusetts.

The Hotline Operator plays a critical role at SafeSpot as the frontline point of contact with our callers. They will be responsible for managing incoming calls and talking with callers using a harm reduction framework. Hotline calls are opportunities to engage people who use drugs in meaningful conversation and the ideal candidate would be comfortable talking to people who are actively using drugs and who come from diverse backgrounds and experiences. The ideal candidate should possess excellent communication skills, a calm demeanor in potentially challenging situations, and a strong dedication to saving lives through prompt and compassionate actions. This role is “pay per call” and has monthly call requirements in order to stay active on the team.

Provides hotline support for the State resource center at BMC for opioid dependence. Answer calls, collects data for the State on callers to assist in service needs, provide callers with names and numbers for treatment. Works with the Opioid treatment nurses and providers on program improvements, dissemination of information, and collaboration. Cross-Team Collaboration

title: Sr. Systems Engineer, ProAV - North Central
description:
This position requires a candidate based in Ohio, Michigan, or the Chicago area, supporting NETGEAR’s ProAV customers across the North Central United States.

The Sr. Systems Engineer, ProAV serves as a technical expert supporting NETGEAR’s ProAV solutions across the North Central U.S. This role combines customer onboarding, field engineering, pre-sales support, and industry engagement. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in AV-over-IP networking, strong troubleshooting capabilities, and the ability to deliver high-impact technical training and solution design.

This is a remote-based position requiring up to 60% travel throughout the region.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Customer Onboarding & Technical Training

- Lead onboarding for U.S. customers implementing NETGEAR ProAV switches and third-party integrations

- Collaborate with the North Central Sales Territory Manager to ensure successful deployments

- Deliver remote and on-site training covering AV-over-IP network design, switch profile selection, PTP configuration, Dante/AVB/Milan configuration, and API integration and video configuration

- Develop customized training materials, system designs, and internal/external knowledge base documentation

- Ensure successful transition into production environments, including complex multi-switch and multi-vendor deployments

Professional Services & Field Engineering

- Provide advanced on-site troubleshooting for high-profile customers experiencing complex timing, multicast, or interoperability issues

- Capture logs, perform packet traces, replicate issues in lab environments, and provide real-time diagnostics

- Support commissioning of AV-over-IP systems to ensure stable production performance

- Resolve escalated issues involving AVB, Dante/AES67, NVX, Q-SYS, SMPTE-2059-2, PTPv2, and multicast networking

Pre-Sales Engineering & Business Expansion

- Support Sales, Business Development, and Channel teams with technical scoping and solution design

- Conduct on-site and virtual product demonstrations

- Assist in Bill of Materials (BOM) creation and system architecture design

- Provide competitive analysis and technical positioning

- Contribute technical expertise to expand NETGEAR’s ProAV presence in the U.S. market

Internal Tools & Documentation Development

- Develop and maintain internal scripts, configuration tools, and deployment utilities

- Create automation tools to reduce troubleshooting time, including log analysis, profile validation, and configuration parsing

- Author best practice guides, training materials, and knowledge base documentation

Industry Representation & Events

- Represent NETGEAR at U.S. industry conferences and partner events

- Deliver technical workshops and presentations

- Provide advanced AV-over-IP education and roadmap overviews

- Support event-based network deployments and multi-vendor interoperability demonstrations

QUALIFICATIONS

- Minimum 5 years of experience in networking systems, AV-over-IP technologies, or related systems engineering roles

- Deep knowledge of ProAV networking products, AV-over-IP technologies, multicast networking and IGMP, and switch profile development

- Strong understanding of routing and switching fundamentals

- Hands-on deployment experience with AVB, Dante, Q-SYS, Crestron, SMPTE-2059-2, and multicast networks

- Field experience troubleshooting complex AV-over-IP systems

- Independent lab development and advanced technical self-study

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree preferred but not required

- Industry certifications such as CCNA, CWNA, AVIXA CTS, Dante, or AVB are beneficial but not required

- Experience working in a Solutions Architect or Systems Engineering capacity preferred

Travel Requirements

- Must be willing to travel up to 60% within the North Central U.S. region

North Dakota, South Dakota, Nebraska, Kansas, Minnesota, Iowa, Wisconsin, Illinois, Michigan, Indiana, Ohio, and Kentucky.

Join the ASI Partners family as a legacy person you can come back to or refer others to as a government career source and interview for a direct-hire REMOTE opportunity with a major subcontractor on a long-term contract (potential to 2029) serving a massive IT modernization effort at the Internal Revenue Service (IRS).

We are looking for a fully-certified Salesforce Quality Assurance guru with at least 7 years ideally doing QA with the government Cloud working on Salesforce/Mulesoft, Agile CI/CD, Security model, Apex, LWC, etc.

Having a Public Trust clearance, a SECRET level government clearance, or having a higher-level clearance would expedite your start date on the contract, but we will also consider strong candidates interested in government service that can stay in place for 4-8 weeks while the clearance process finalizes. WE CAN ONLY ACCEPT U.S. CITIZENS and will verify personal information after the initial interview was successful to move forward.

So, what is the major modernization effort?

Older modernization roadmaps lacked long-term retirement strategies for core mainframes so IRS leadership rolled out a new technical framework stretching through 2029 with heavy emphasis on building a Unified API Layer to unlock legacy data. The IRS plans to wrap up its move toward a single, unified Enterprise Case Management (ECM) system. This platform will consolidate siloed databases and allow employees to support taxpayers from a single interface.

Fiscal Year 2028 Target : This is the projected completion window for updating the critical Individual Master File (IMF). The IMF has processed individual taxpayer data since 1970 using outdated COBOL and Assembly Language Code. The IRS aims to fully convert this core code into modern, developer-friendly Java.

By establishing a solid data structure and robust DevOps pipeline (using tools like SFDX and Git), the subcontractor we are hiring for helps create the stable infrastructure required for the IRS Office of Chief Counsel, the Taxpayer Advocate Service, and the Office of Appeals to safely adopt these modern AI systems.

That spans the user-facing experience (what Claude remembers, how people see and edit it, how search surfaces the right conversation) and the shared infrastructure underneath it, the memory service, indexing, retrieval and vector search.

Memory is one of the biggest levers on whether Claude feels like it knows you. We recently moved memory from a periodically synthesized summary to a dynamic, editable, on-demand system, and then unified it so the same memory follows you across products. Search went from a top user complaint to something people rely on to find past work. Share the on-call for the systems you own

WHAT WE'RE RESEARCHING

We're running a paid study on go-to-market strategies tailored to independent retail operations. Specifically, we are evaluating a new appointment management tool designed for independent bicycle repair shops. HOW IT WORKS

You will complete an asynchronous, remote review of a short go-to-market brief. During this task, you will read through our target audience assumptions, proposed messaging, and launch plan. Candidates should have a strong grasp of market validation techniques and startup strategy. Familiarity with independent bike shops or local service businesses is a strong plus, though not strictly required.

- Read and evaluate a short go-to-market strategy brief for a bike shop appointment tool

title: AI Residency Program, Physical Sciences
description:
Your Impact at LILA

The Lila Sciences AI Residency is a full-time research program at the intersection of artificial intelligence and materials science. Residents join a cohort of researchers tackling open-ended scientific challenges alongside Lila's scientists and engineers, with the option to focus on fundamental or applied research.

Residencies run 6 to 12 months, with extension possible. First residencies begin in spring 2027, with rolling applications and additional intakes in fall 2027. Residents are paired with technical mentors, receive feedback from cross-functional teams, and work with proprietary datasets, high-performance compute, and Lila's research infrastructure. Publishing is encouraged but not required. What matters most is pushing the frontier of scientific discovery.

Priority research areas for the 2027 cohort span four domains:

• Soft matter and formulation intelligence: composition-process-property modeling, representation learning for mixtures and formulations, physics-informed and simulation-augmented predictive models, and generative models for 3D soft-material structures at the mesoscale and microscale (colloidal assemblies, phase-separated domains, particle networks, film and bulk morphologies)

• Physics-based simulation and in silico discovery: agentic frameworks for physics-based and multiphysics or multiscale simulations, and methods that orchestrate and bridge across simulation scales

• Chemistry-aware AI and molecular design: molecular representations (graphs, protein-ligand structures, MD trajectories), chemistry-reasoning agents, predictive models for synthesis, analysis, and purification, and experimental decision-making under uncertainty and operational constraints

• Foundational AI for materials science: sequential decision-making under real-world constraints, multimodal learning, reasoning and benchmarking, generative models and representation learning, and scientific machine learning

Applications require a resume and a research proposal of up to three pages (unlimited references) outlining the project you would pursue during your residency. Submit the research proposal as your cover letter. Applications without both documents will not be considered. Optional supporting materials such as recommendation letters, publications, or research artifacts are welcome.

What You'll Be Building

• Design and execute independent research projects in AI for materials science

• Pursue work in one or more of the 2027 priority research areas

• Collaborate with Lila scientists and engineers on open-science initiatives

• Co-develop novel approaches to scientific discovery with the wider team

• Use Lila's datasets, compute, and infrastructure to test ambitious hypotheses

• Share findings internally and externally; publication is welcome, not mandatory

What You'll Need to Succeed

• Degree in materials science, chemistry, computer science, AI/ML, physics, mathematics, or a related field (Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD)

• Proficiency in Python and deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch

• Experience working with large-scale datasets or simulations

• Familiarity with modern AI/ML architectures and training techniques

• Strong research background shown through publications, thesis work, or open-source projects

Bonus Points For

• Prior ML work in scientific domains such as materials discovery, chemistry, or simulation

• Experience in one or more of the 2027 priority research areas

• Open-source contributions or collaborative research experience

• Clear writing and communication on complex scientific ideas

About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

The IP Infrastructure team builds and operates the systems that enable OpenAI to share research and engineering technology securely and reliably with strategic partners. Our work spans continuously running pipelines for model weights, configurations, code, and container images.

title: Rostering Coordinator (7X74WR45)
description:
Fully Remote - South Africa | Independent Contractor | Full-Time, UK office hours | A UK domiciliary care provider
About the Role
Outsource Ability is recruiting on behalf of a UK domiciliary care provider for an experienced and organised Rostering Coordinator. The provider delivers approximately 2,000 hours of home care each week across around 90 care staff.
You will plan, maintain and adjust care workers' schedules so that client visits are covered consistently, staff availability is used effectively and travel between visits is practical. This is not a data-entry role. It requires independent judgement and active problem-solving across a two-week rolling rota.
This role covers rostering only. You will not change assessed care needs, reduce agreed care durations or decide that a required visit can be missed. Unresolved staffing and care-delivery risks must be escalated to the designated line manager.
Key Responsibilities

• Maintain the two-week rolling rota, keeping regular clients with the same care worker wherever practical.

• Complete the following week's rota each Monday to Tuesday, recording leave, sickness and visit changes accurately.

• Monitor and resolve uncovered visits, which can exceed 100 during busy periods, by reorganising runs and contacting staff for additional availability.

• Use bank staff and pickup arrangements for short-term and weekend cover rather than permanent runs.

• Plan runs using full client postcodes, allowing practical travel time between visits.

• Allocate work within each care worker's availability and contracted hours, avoiding over-allocation or double-booking.

• Assess new care packages against geography, visit times and staff capacity, working to the Wednesday cut-off for Monday starts.

• Keep the rostering system accurate and handle client and staff information confidentially.

• Escalate uncovered visits and operational risks to the designated line manager, with a summary of action taken.

Systems

• CareFree (or a similar care-scheduling platform)
Experience with every system is not essential, but you must be confident learning new technology.
What We're Looking For
Essential

• Demonstrable experience coordinating high-volume schedules, staff rotas, dispatch or comparable logistics work.

• Ability to solve multi-step scheduling problems and see how one change affects other visits, staff and routes.

• Excellent accuracy and numerical confidence when tracking staff hours, gaps and deadlines.

• Clear written and spoken English, with confidence contacting staff and updating UK colleagues remotely.

• Sound decision-making under pressure, with the judgement to escalate an unresolved visit promptly.

• Confident use of scheduling software.

• Ability to work securely with confidential information.

Advantageous

• Experience in domiciliary care, healthcare or another time-critical visiting service.

• Experience using CareFree or a similar care-scheduling platform.

• Familiarity with UK postcodes, local route planning and two-week repeating rota patterns.

Remote Work Requirements
Applicants must:

• Be based in South Africa.

• Have a modern laptop or PC with an Intel i5 / AMD Ryzen 5 processor or equivalent and a minimum of 8GB RAM.

• Have a stable fibre connection with a minimum of 50 Mbps download and 50 Mbps upload.

• Have a functional UPS, inverter or power station able to run the router and laptop for a minimum of 2-4 hours during load shedding.

• Have a professional noise-cancelling headset with a clear microphone.

• Have a quiet workspace suitable for calls and video meetings.

• Be available for the agreed full-time hours during UK office times.

title: ML Compiler & System
description: What Quadrants is Quadrants is an open-source translation layer that turns ordinary Python into optimized machine code at runtime, across CPU (Arm64, x86) and GPU (AMDGPU, CUDA, Metal, Vulkan) backends. CUDA is the primary target, with x86 the strong runner-up, especially for real-time simulation. The others drive adoption and support fast prototyping for research. The ambition is explicit: build the best “Python compiler” in the world for physics and performance-critical numerical computing. We are fully committed to it, and we intend to beat leading alternatives like Nvidia Warp, Numba, or Triton. It’s a standalone project with its own roadmap, built in the open. Genesis, our physics simulator, is its first and top-priority user, the source of its hardest workloads and its benchmarks. But Quadrants is general-purpose infrastructure for anyone writing performance-critical numerical Python, not an internal tool that happens to be public. The bet: high-performance code should feel natural to write. Engineers write plain Python in a NumPy or PyTorch style, and Quadrants makes it fast.   The role You own Quadrants end to end: the API, the IR and lowering, the optimization passes, the numerical primitives, and the roadmap. Our ultimate objective: engineers write for readability and maintainability, never for performance. They write the version of an algorithm they are most comfortable with, and Quadrants rebuilds it into kernels that run as if an expert had hand-tuned them. Performance is the compiler’s job, not theirs. Getting there is a frontier problem, part research and part engineering, and we intend to define the state of the art on it, relentlessly pushing the limit further.

description:
ABOUT FOCUSED ENERGY

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A - the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry - we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

YOUR ROLE

Building a fusion company across two continents takes focus, strong relationships and thoughtful coordination. Our CEO works closely with investors, governments, strategic partners and the leadership team. You create the structure that helps him use his time effectively and arrive prepared.

This is the most senior executive support role at Focused Energy. You will work directly with the CEO as part of a closely coordinated CEO Office, in partnership with and reporting to the Chief of Staff. You will take ownership of the operational infrastructure supporting the CEO, including diary and calendar management, travel coordination, executive administration and stakeholder logistics. The Chief of Staff leads strategic priorities, substantive briefings, executive alignment and follow-through on key decisions. You ensure the practical arrangements and information flow support those priorities effectively.

When a delegation trip with twelve meetings across three countries changes at short notice, you bring the overview and experience to rebuild the plan, coordinate the people involved and keep everyone informed. You enjoy solving complex logistics and creating clarity when plans change.

You will exercise sound judgment and make day-to-day decisions independently within agreed parameters, knowing when to escalate strategic conflicts or sensitive matters. You will help establish reliable, efficient ways of working as the CEO Office develops.

You represent the CEO Office to investors, ministries, partner companies and board members. As the most experienced EA in the company, you also help shape how executive support works across Focused Energy.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Plan and coordinate the CEO’s domestic and international travel, including complex delegations, conferences and investor or government engagements.

- Own itineraries, participants, visas, invitations, registrations, protocol requirements, ground logistics, contingency arrangements and live coordination during trips.

- Be willing to accompany the CEO internationally when needed, independently or alongside the Chief of Staff, while providing effective remote support on trips you do not attend.

- Maintain a clear overview of upcoming commitments and what each requires. Anticipate conflicts, preparation needs and logistical dependencies, and act early.

- Coordinate the timely preparation, collation and distribution of briefing materials, working with the Chief of Staff and relevant content owners.

- Maintain clear administrative follow-up and ensure decisions, commitments and emerging priorities are promptly communicated to the Chief of Staff for strategic follow-through.

- Build trusted relationships with investors, ministries, agencies, partner companies, board members and their offices.

- Keep the CEO Office running effectively, including expenses, approvals, signatures, tools, records and contact management.

- Help develop shared standards for calendar management, travel, tools and confidentiality, supporting collaboration and teamwork across the EA team, both locally and internationally.

WHO YOU ARE

- You bring ten or more years of experience in executive support, including several years supporting a CEO, founder or managing director in an international business with extensive travel and calendar management. Experience in a growing company or investor environment is a plus.

title: Accounting Lead, Hardware
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

OpenAI Finance is responsible for ensuring the organization is set up for success in pursuit of its mission to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity.

The Controllership team delivers the financial truth that powers OpenAI’s growth. By translating operational activity into accurate, timely, and decision-grade financial data, we enable leadership to scale the business with confidence. Our commitment to rigorous controls and best-in-class systems ensures financial integrity as OpenAI grows. 

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a strategic and execution-oriented Accounting Lead, Hardware to build and scale inventory accounting capabilities across consumer hardware and robotics businesses. This role partners closely with Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing Operations, Technical Accounting, Strategic Finance, and Systems teams to establish scalable inventory and supply chain accounting processes and reporting infrastructure supporting rapid growth and product launches.

The ideal candidate brings strong accounting fundamentals, sound judgment, and a track record of building scalable processes in complex, evolving businesses. Inventory, cost accounting, or supply chain experience is preferred, and accounting experience supporting hardware, infrastructure, data centers, or other capital-intensive operations is also valuable. We welcome strong accounting professionals from other backgrounds who have demonstrated the ability to quickly learn unfamiliar business models and accounting topics and take ownership of new areas. This person should thrive in ambiguity, combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and communicate effectively with cross-functional partners and senior leadership.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

 

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: 

INVENTORY ACCOUNTING

- Lead inventory and supply chain accounting across consumer hardware and robotics programs, including inventory valuation, supply chain/sourcing arrangements, manufacturing variances, reserves, and close processes.

- Partner with Supply Chain, Operations, and Strategic Finance to support BOM accuracy, labor and overhead assumptions, operationalize supply chain strategies and gross margin analysis.

- Develop scalable accounting processes for NPI, prototyping, engineering builds, and mass production.

- Own inventory-related accounting policies and controls, including capitalization, overhead allocation, LCNRV/NRV assessments, rebates, freight, tariffs, and inventory controls.

ERP SYSTEMS & PROCESS DESIGN

- Serve as a finance lead for Oracle Fusion manufacturing costing and inventory implementations, enhancements, and process optimization.

- Partner with Systems, IT, and Operations to design scalable finance processes, controls, reporting structures, and operational workflows.

- Partner with Systems and Operations to define accounting requirements and guide ERP design for product costing, inventory transactions, and related reporting and controls.

FINANCIAL CLOSE, REPORTING & CONTROLS

- Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual cost accounting close activities and improve scalable reconciliations, reporting, and management review processes.

- Partner with Strategic Finance on margin reporting, inventory analytics, and budget versus actual analysis.

- Establish SOX-ready controls, support audits and technical accounting matters, and drive continuous improvement across close and reporting processes.

CROSS-FUNCTIONAL LEADERSHIP

- Act as a strategic partner to Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Program Management teams.

- Translate ambiguous business needs into scalable accounting and operational frameworks.

- Influence senior stakeholders through strong communication, executive presence, and data-driven recommendations.

- Help build and scale the long-term roadmap for hardware controllers

title: Plannings- en trafficcoördinator voor een creatieve studio (Freelance mogelijk)
description:
📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden
De creatieve studio binnen de communicatieafdeling ondersteunt interne communicatie- en marketingteams met creatieve concepten en communicatiemiddelen voor online en offline gebruik. Het team van ongeveer tien medewerkers werkt onder meer aan copywriting, grafisch ontwerp, fotografie, video, nieuwsbrieven en sociale media, in samenwerking met interne stakeholders en externe partners.
Voor een proefopstelling rond planning en traffic management zoeken we een collega die onderzoekt welke processen en structuur het best werken. Je werkt deze aanpak uit, test ze in de praktijk en neemt tijdens de testfase een coördinerende rol op.
Je helpt een duidelijke werkstroom uit te bouwen zodat projecten volgens briefing, timing en budget verlopen, van intake tot oplevering. Met een efficiënte aanpak voor planning en traffic geef je creatieve medewerkers meer ruimte voor hun inhoudelijke werk en ondersteun je interne opdrachtgevers beter. De inzichten uit deze test vormen de basis voor een definitieve aanpak die in 2027 wordt uitgewerkt.
Je werkt volgens een gericht stappenplan, in afstemming met het diensthoofd van de studio:

• Je analyseert de huidige werking van de studio op het vlak van planning en traffic en brengt de samenwerking met interne opdrachtgevers in kaart.

• Je werkt een duurzame structuur uit met duidelijke processen, tools en rollen. Daarbij bewaak je een kostenefficiënte werking.

• Je introduceert, test en verfijnt deze structuur in de studio.

• Tijdens de testfase ben je het eerste aanspreekpunt voor de leidinggevende, interne opdrachtgevers en creatieve medewerkers.

• Je stelt de projectplanning voor lopende opdrachten op, bewaakt ze en optimaliseert ze waar nodig.

• Je vertaalt briefings naar concrete tijdslijnen, deliverables en capaciteitsinschattingen.

• Bij piekbelasting bepaal je prioriteiten en neem je beslissingen over de planning.

• Je brengt de beschikbare capaciteit van creatieve medewerkers in kaart en verdeelt de opdrachten.

• Wanneer de interne capaciteit niet volstaat, stem je tijdig extra interne of externe ondersteuning af.

• Je organiseert de planningsafstemming met creatieve teams, de leidinggevende en interne opdrachtgevers.

• Je faciliteert stand-ups, weekplanningen en statusupdates.

• Je zorgt voor duidelijkheid over verantwoordelijkheden, deadlines en randvoorwaarden.

• Je beheert de ondersteunende planningstools en gebruikt geschikte technologie of vergelijkbare oplossingen voor de planning en opvolging.

• Je legt vanuit planning en traffic de verbinding met budgetbeheer en volgt de kosten op.

• Je doet proactief voorstellen voor bijkomende taken of structuren die de operationele flow in de studio verbeteren.

• Je kunt eventueel de overgang van de testopstelling naar de definitieve structuur mee faciliteren.

Deze functie omvat geen formele leidinggevende verantwoordelijkheid, creatieve uitwerking of creatief management.
📝 Jouw profiel

• Je hebt ervaring in een creatief bureau, een creatieve studio of een productieomgeving.

• Je bent vertrouwd met planningstools en met de relevante planningstechnologie of een vergelijkbare technologie.

• Je hebt ervaring met het faciliteren van stand-ups, weekplanningen of gelijkaardige overlegmomenten.

• Je hebt kennis van kostencalculatie, timing en workloadmanagement.

• Je beschikt over ervaring met projectmanagement.

• Je communiceert duidelijk, empathisch en to the point. Tijdens een interview kan je dit overtuigend aantonen.

• Je voegt bij je kandidatuur een document toe met een voorbeeld van een eerder uitgewerkte procesflow.

• Ervaring in een creatieve rol, zoals content creator, copywriter of grafisch ontwerper, is een pluspunt.

• Ervaring in een leidinggevende functie is een pluspunt, ook al bevat deze rol zelf geen formele leidinggevende verantwoordelijkheid.

• Je hebt ervaring met procesanalyse en procesoptimalisatie.

title: AI Evaluation Specialist/Recent Grad - Remote
description:
Job Description: Evaluation Specialist / Recent Graduate
Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote
Job Summary
We are seeking motivated Evaluation Specialists and recent graduates to contribute to a high-impact project focused on advancing artificial intelligence. In this role, you will use your research, analytical reasoning, and writing skills to develop challenging questions and evaluate AI model performance.
You will create original question-and-answer pairs, conduct in-depth research, verify information across multiple sources, and provide clear explanations supported by reliable citations. No prior AI experience is required. Strong research abilities, critical thinking, and subject-matter knowledge are the key requirements.
Scope of Work

• Develop original, challenging question-and-answer pairs designed to test the capabilities of advanced AI models across diverse subject areas.

• Conduct in-depth research and cross-verify information using multiple reliable sources to ensure accuracy, completeness, and strong supporting evidence.

• Create multi-step questions that require analytical reasoning, synthesis, and critical thinking rather than simple information retrieval.

• Test questions against AI models, analyze their responses, and refine the questions to adjust or increase their difficulty.

• Document research processes and provide clear citations, evidence, and logical explanations to support each answer.

• Revise and improve content based on reviewer feedback while ensuring compliance with project guidelines and quality standards.

• Maintain consistency, accuracy, and clarity across all submitted tasks.

Preferred Qualifications

• Strong ability to conduct independent research and critically evaluate information from multiple sources.

• Excellent English writing skills, with a high level of precision and clarity. English fluency is required but does not need to be your first language.

• Ability to create nuanced, well-structured questions that assess deep understanding and complex reasoning.

• Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and information-synthesis skills.

• Self-motivation, reliability, and accountability when working independently in a remote environment.

• Interest in emerging AI technologies and evaluating the capabilities and limitations of advanced AI models.

• Previous experience in AI training, model evaluation, research, or content creation is an advantage but is not required.

• Open to recent graduates, advanced-degree holders, and candidates from diverse academic or professional backgrounds who demonstrate strong research and writing abilities.

Compensation Structure

title: SOC Service Delivery Manager
description:
Summary
The SOC Service Delivery Manager serves as the primary customer success leader for assigned Managed Security Services customers and is accountable for service performance, security governance, customer health, adoption, incident communications, and value realization. The role translates cybersecurity operations into meaningful business outcomes by building executive relationships, proactively managing customer health, and helping customers realize value from their partnership with Logicalis.
The role connects customers with Security Operations teams and aligns technical delivery with business priorities, security objectives, contractual commitments, and desired outcomes. The SOC Service Delivery Manager partners with SOC analysts, security engineers, solution architects, Account Executives, Customer Success leaders, and customer stakeholders to strengthen customer confidence, improve security outcomes, and support retention and long-term partnership success.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Customer Success, Relationship and Health Management

• Serves as the primary operational relationship owner and trusted advisor for assigned Managed Security Services customers, builds relationships with executive sponsors and customer stakeholders, and maintains an understanding of each customer’s business objectives, security priorities, compliance requirements, risks, opportunities, and success measures.

• Aligns service delivery and continuous improvement to desired outcomes; monitors customer health, engagement, adoption, satisfaction, operational risk, and renewal risk; develops mitigation and service improvement plans for at-risk customers; and translates performance data into business insights and recommendations that support retention and renewal readiness.

Security Service Delivery, Governance and Value

• Owns the customer delivery experience for assigned Managed Security Services accounts and leads service reviews, business reviews, executive reviews, and security performance discussions to ensure alignment with contractual commitments, customer expectations, and desired outcomes.

• Reviews and communicates SLA performance, operational effectiveness, security trends, customer sentiment, performance measures, risks, and improvement opportunities in language appropriate for executive, business, and technical stakeholders, while driving accountability for commitments, remediation plans, operational deliverables, service quality, adoption, and customer value.

• Serves as the primary customer communication lead during critical security incidents, significant service-impacting events, and escalations, and coordinates SOC analysts, security engineers, vendors, Account Executives, and other stakeholders through resolution with timely, accurate, and transparent communications.

• Translates technical findings, threat data, and business risk into executive-level communications and recommendations; leads escalations and post-incident reviews; analyzes incident and escalation trends; and tracks corrective actions to completion to reduce recurring customer friction.

Onboarding, Adoption and Continuous Improvement
